title: Model Fighting Style, Metamagic, and Hunter option features
description:
Problem:
Several high-use option families are prose-only or generic-choice-only:
- Fighting Style options such as Archery, Defense, Dueling, Great Weapon Fighting, Protection, and Two-Weapon Fighting.
- feature:sorcerer:metamagic options.
- Hunter subclass options:
  - Hunter's Prey: Colossus Slayer, Giant Killer, Horde Breaker.
  - Defensive Tactics: Escape the Horde, Multiattack Defense, Steel Will.
  - Multiattack: Volley, Whirlwind Attack.
  - Superior Hunter's Defense: Evasion, Stand Against the Tide, Uncanny Dodge.

Implement:
- Emit structured option catalogs for each family.
- Link parent feature choices to those catalogs.
- Include source text, source locations, and stable ids for each option.
- Model prerequisites only where the SRD has explicit prerequisites.
- Keep option effects prose-backed unless deterministic projection is straightforward and separately tested.

Acceptance criteria:
- Character creation can enumerate and persist Fighting Style selections.
- Character creation can enumerate and persist Metamagic selections.
- Character creation can enumerate and persist Hunter subclass feature choices at levels 3, 7, 11, and 15.
- The choice-bearing prose audit no longer flags these records.
- Existing tests and pack verification pass.
close_reason: Implemented Fighting Style, Metamagic, Champion additional style, and Hunter option catalogs
